newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane climbs in short-coverings.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane climbs in short-coverings.

text.p: U.S. spot propane trading was relatively heavy amid gains in the NYMEX and traders covering shorts, players said.
In the Conway, Kansas hub propane deals started at 37.00 cents a gallon. Deals climbed incrementally and reached 37.75 cents, about a penny higher than it was pegged Monday, traders said.
"Some traders are panicking and covering shorts," one Conway trader said. "Even though there's a lot of inventory, it's all spoken for, and immediate barrels are hard to find."
Belvieu, Texas propane for August was done at 36.25 and 36.50 cents, about even with Monday's values. September propane leapt to 37.75 cents, done in a 100,000 barrel parcel.
"I'm sure the seller thought that was a good price," one Belvieu trader said.
Natural gasoline deals in Belivieu climbed from 22.25 to 22.75 cents. Propane purity deals there climbed from 21.75 to 22.75 cents.
